Those who have been studied in the university of love, who remain serene & refined, distant from all noise & commotion ; only they can teach the art of love in its truest form . Sartaaj, what could you possibly learn of this from a book ? Let’s learn the idiom of signs & glances as the whole mystery lies within the language of the eyes. What measure of courage & devotion shall be revealed. People keep asking ; tell them, if you may ! Those who have been studied in the university of love, who remain serene & refined, distant from all noise & commotion ; only they can teach the art of love in its truest form . Sartaaj, what could you possibly learn of this from a book ?
